name: CIF number is unique across the customer master
remediation: Route duplicates to the stewardship merge queue; suppress from aggregation until resolved.

name: Every account references an existing CIF
expression: count(accounts a LEFT JOIN cif c ON a.cif_no = c.cif_no WHERE c.cif_no IS NULL) = 0
remediation: Orphaned accounts are excluded from customer aggregation and raised as a blocker to the account owner.

name: CNIC conforms to the 13-digit national format
remediation: Reject at capture; queue historical failures for branch remediation with a target date.

name: CNIC is not a known placeholder or repeated-digit value
expression: cnic NOT IN (placeholder_list) AND NOT regexp_like(cnic, '^(\d)\1{12}$')
remediation: Placeholder identities indicate an onboarding control failure — escalate to the branch and to compliance.

name: CNIC present for all individual customers
expression: cnic IS NOT NULL WHERE customer_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
remediation: Missing identity on an individual customer blocks KYC currency; restrict the account pending remediation.

name: One active CIF per CNIC unless a documented exception exists
expression: count(DISTINCT cif_no) OVER (PARTITION BY cnic) = 1 OR exception_flag = 'Y'
remediation: Multiple CIFs on one identity break single customer view — route to the merge queue.

name: NTN present for corporate and business customers
expression: ntn IS NOT NULL WHERE customer_type IN ('COMPANY','PARTNERSHIP','SOLE_PROP')
remediation: Escalate to relationship manager; blocks accurate tax reporting on the relationship.

name: Customer type is a value from the governed code set
expression: customer_type IN (SELECT code FROM ref_customer_type WHERE active = 'Y')
remediation: Invalid types misclassify the customer in sectoral returns — correct at source before submission.

name: Customer type is consistent between core banking and the credit system
remediation: Reconcile to the designated system of record; investigate the interface if breaks are systematic.

name: AML risk rating assigned to every active customer
expression: aml_risk_rating IS NOT NULL WHERE customer_status = 'ACTIVE'
remediation: Unrated customers cannot be correctly monitored — escalate to compliance same day.

name: AML risk rating reassessed within its rating-driven cycle
remediation: Overdue reassessments are reported to compliance with an ageing profile.

name: KYC review is not overdue
remediation: Overdue KYC drives account restriction workflow and is reported to the council monthly.

name: Beneficial owner recorded for corporate customers
remediation: A corporate relationship without recorded beneficial ownership is a direct examination finding.

name: Group linkage recorded for borrowers above the group-exposure threshold
expression: group_id IS NOT NULL WHERE total_exposure > group_review_threshold
remediation: Missing linkage understates group exposure against limits — escalate to credit risk immediately.

name: Group linkage contains no circular references
remediation: Circular linkage causes aggregation to double-count or fail to terminate — fix the relationship record.

name: PEP screening result recorded for all customers
expression: pep_flag IS NOT NULL AND last_screening_date IS NOT NULL
remediation: Unscreened customers are reported to compliance daily until cleared.

name: Country codes conform to the governed ISO country reference set
remediation: Invalid country codes corrupt cross-border and non-resident reporting.

name: Account number is unique within the account master
remediation: Duplicate account keys break every downstream join — halt the load and escalate to the custodian.

name: Account status is a governed code-set value
expression: account_status IN (SELECT code FROM ref_account_status WHERE active = 'Y')
remediation: Unknown statuses default into the wrong reporting bucket — correct before submission.

name: Dormancy flag agrees with the last-activity date rule
remediation: Mismatches misstate dormant and unclaimed reporting — reconcile the dormancy job against policy.

name: Closed accounts carry no residual balance
remediation: Balances on closed accounts break the GL reconciliation and indicate a closure-process defect.

name: Sum of account balances reconciles to the GL control account
remediation: The primary period-end control. Breaks are investigated before any return is submitted.

name: Balance snapshot is as at the correct reporting date
remediation: A stale snapshot silently reports the prior period — block downstream processing on failure.

name: Product code exists in the governed product master
expression: product_code IN (SELECT code FROM product_master WHERE active = 'Y')
remediation: Unmapped products fall out of regulatory classification — register the product before it is sold.

name: Every product code maps to a regulatory reporting category
remediation: Unmapped products are excluded from returns or land in a residual bucket — a direct reporting error.

name: Currency code is a valid governed ISO currency
expression: currency_code IN (SELECT iso_code FROM ref_currency WHERE active = 'Y')
remediation: Invalid currencies break revaluation and open-position reporting.

name: Account opening date is not in the future and not implausibly historic
remediation: Implausible dates usually indicate a migration defect — investigate by source batch.

name: Term deposits carry a maturity date
expression: maturity_date IS NOT NULL WHERE product_class = 'TERM'
remediation: Missing maturity defaults the deposit into the wrong liquidity bucket, distorting LCR and the ladder.

name: Maturity date is later than the opening date
remediation: Inverted dates place the deposit in an overdue bucket and misstate the maturity ladder.

name: Deposit rate is within the approved product rate band
remediation: Out-of-band rates indicate unauthorised pricing or a data defect — both require escalation.

name: Savings rate is not below the regulatory minimum
remediation: A compliance breach as well as a data issue — escalate to compliance and product simultaneously.

name: Islamic indicator is consistent between product master and GL book
remediation: Mixing books breaches the separate-books requirement and invalidates profit distribution.

name: Branch code exists in the active organisational hierarchy
expression: branch_code IN (SELECT code FROM org_hierarchy WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')
remediation: Closed or unknown branch codes corrupt regional aggregation — remap to the surviving unit.

name: Loan outstanding reconciles to the GL advances control account
remediation: Break must be cleared before advances reporting is submitted; ageing tracked at council.

name: Outstanding principal is not negative
remediation: Negative principal indicates a mispost or over-recovery — investigate at transaction level.

name: Outstanding does not exceed sanctioned limit without an approved excess
expression: principal_outstanding <= sanctioned_limit OR excess_approval_ref IS NOT NULL
remediation: Unapproved excesses are both a credit control failure and a data defect — dual escalation.

name: Sanctioned limit present for all revolving facilities
expression: sanctioned_limit IS NOT NULL WHERE facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
remediation: Missing limits understate undrawn commitments and the associated capital charge.

name: Days past due recomputes correctly from the earliest unpaid instalment
remediation: DPD drives classification and staging — any error propagates directly into provisioning.

name: Days past due is zero when there are no unpaid dues
remediation: Residual DPD after cure misclassifies performing loans as delinquent.

name: Asset classification is consistent with the days-past-due band
expression: classification = classification_for_dpd_band(dpd) OR manual_override_ref IS NOT NULL
remediation: Undocumented downgrade suppression is an examination finding — every override requires a reference.

name: Classification is uniform across all facilities of the same borrower
expression: count(DISTINCT classification) OVER (PARTITION BY cif_no) = 1 OR split_approval_ref IS NOT NULL
remediation: Borrower-level classification contagion is expected; splits require documented approval.

name: IFRS 9 stage is consistent with prudential classification
remediation: A stage-1 classification on an impaired facility materially understates ECL.

name: Every facility in scope carries an IFRS 9 stage
remediation: Unstaged facilities are silently excluded from ECL — reconcile scope counts every run.

name: Restructured facilities are not staged as performing without a cure period
expression: NOT (restructured_flag = 'Y' AND ifrs9_stage = 1 AND months_since_restructure < cure_period_months)
remediation: Premature cure is a recurring audit finding — enforce the cure period in the staging engine.

name: Probability of default is within the unit interval and non-zero
remediation: A zero or null PD produces zero ECL silently — block the model run on failure.

name: Loss given default is within the unit interval
remediation: Out-of-range LGD indicates a collateral haircut defect — trace to the valuation input.

name: Exposure at default is at least the drawn outstanding balance
remediation: EAD below drawn balance understates loss — check the credit conversion factor application.

name: Facility maturity date is present for all term facilities
expression: maturity_date IS NOT NULL WHERE facility_type = 'TERM'
remediation: Missing maturity defaults the facility into the shortest repricing bucket and distorts IRRBB.

name: Floating-rate facilities carry a benchmark and repricing frequency
expression: benchmark_code IS NOT NULL AND repricing_freq IS NOT NULL WHERE rate_type = 'FLOATING'
remediation: Without a repricing basis the facility is modelled as fixed, understating rate sensitivity.

name: Benchmark code exists in the governed rate reference set
expression: benchmark_code IN (SELECT code FROM ref_benchmark WHERE active = 'Y')
remediation: Retired benchmarks must be remapped before the next repricing cycle.

name: Economic sector code present on all advances
remediation: Missing sector codes fall into a residual bucket that distorts concentration reporting.

name: Provision held meets or exceeds the prudential minimum for the classification
remediation: Under-provisioning is a reportable breach — escalate to CFO and CRO on detection.

name: Provision subledger reconciles to the GL provision accounts
remediation: A break here directly misstates the financial statements — clear before period close.

name: Collateral valuation is within the permitted revaluation age
remediation: Stale valuations cannot be relied on for provisioning benefit — suppress the benefit until revalued.

name: Collateral value is positive and within a plausible range for its type
remediation: Outliers usually indicate a units or currency error — verify against the valuation report.

name: Eligibility flag agrees with the governed eligible-collateral type list
expression: eligible_flag = ('Y' IF collateral_type IN eligible_types ELSE 'N')
remediation: Incorrectly eligible collateral overstates risk mitigation and understates provisioning.

name: Allocated collateral value does not exceed the item's total value
remediation: Over-allocation double-counts security benefit across facilities — a direct provisioning understatement.

name: Every collateral allocation references an existing active facility
expression: facility_id IN (SELECT facility_id FROM facilities WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')
remediation: Orphaned allocations indicate security not released on closure — review the release process.

name: Card outstanding does not exceed the approved credit limit without authorisation
remediation: Persistent over-limit balances indicate an authorisation control gap; report to cards and risk.

name: Transaction debits and credits balance within each batch
remediation: An unbalanced batch cannot be posted — halt and escalate to operations before period close.

name: Purpose code present on all cross-border transactions
expression: purpose_code IS NOT NULL WHERE txn_type = 'CROSS_BORDER'
remediation: Missing purpose codes invalidate balance-of-payments classification and monitoring scenarios.

name: Originator and beneficiary details complete on wire transfers
expression: originator_name IS NOT NULL AND originator_account IS NOT NULL AND beneficiary_name IS NOT NULL
remediation: Incomplete wire information is a direct regulatory breach — block or return the transfer.

name: Value date is not later than posting date beyond permitted tolerance
remediation: Excessive backdating distorts accrual and period cut-off; review the authorisation for each exception.

name: No transactions posted after the period cut-off into a closed period
expression: count(*) WHERE posting_date <= period_end AND created_ts > period_close_ts) = 0
remediation: Post-close postings invalidate an already-submitted return — requires resubmission assessment.

name: GL account code exists in the active chart of accounts
expression: gl_account IN (SELECT account_code FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')
remediation: Postings to inactive accounts fall outside the reporting mapping — correct before close.

name: Every active GL account maps to a regulatory chart-of-accounts line
expression: count(gl_accounts WHERE rcoa_line IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE') = 0
remediation: The most frequently examined mapping in the estate — unmapped accounts must be resolved before submission.

name: Regulatory mapping is unchanged from the prior period without an approved change record
expression: mapping_hash = prior_period_mapping_hash OR change_approval_ref IS NOT NULL
remediation: Silent mapping changes cause unexplained period-on-period movement — require an approval reference.

name: Trial balance nets to zero for the reporting period
remediation: The fundamental control — a non-zero trial balance blocks all downstream reporting.

name: Cost centre present on all income and expense postings
expression: cost_centre IS NOT NULL WHERE account_type IN ('INCOME','EXPENSE')
remediation: Unattributed income and expense distorts segment and branch profitability.

name: FX revaluation rate is dated as at the reporting date
remediation: A stale rate misstates revaluation and net open position — block the revaluation run on failure.

name: FX rate is within a tolerance band of the prior day
remediation: Large unexplained moves indicate a feed error rather than a market move — verify before use.

name: Investment classification is a permitted category and reclassification is authorised
expression: portfolio_class IN ('HTM','AFS','HFT') AND (portfolio_class = prior_class OR reclass_approval_ref IS NOT NULL)
remediation: Unauthorised reclassification between portfolios is an accounting and regulatory issue — escalate to CFO.

name: Statutory liquidity eligible flag agrees with the instrument eligibility reference
remediation: Incorrect eligibility misstates statutory reserve compliance — a reportable breach if it understates.

name: Behavioural assumptions are applied to all non-maturity deposits
expression: behavioural_profile_id IS NOT NULL WHERE product_class = 'NON_MATURITY'
remediation: Unassigned deposits default to overnight, materially distorting the liquidity ladder and EVE.

name: Behavioural assumptions have been recalibrated within the approved review cycle
remediation: Stale behavioural assumptions are a standing ALCO and audit finding — schedule recalibration.

name: Every governed CDE has an approved glossary definition
remediation: An undefined CDE cannot be governed — assign to the domain steward with a due date.

name: Every governed CDE carries a sensitivity classification
remediation: Unclassified elements cannot be cleared for AI or third-party processing — blocks the readiness gate.

name: Every governed CDE has a named owner and steward
expression: owner_id IS NOT NULL AND steward_id IS NOT NULL
remediation: Unassigned elements are reported to council as open risks rather than silently carried.

name: Named owners and stewards are current employees in the expected function
remediation: Ownership orphaned by a leaver is the most common cause of silent governance decay — reassign within SLA.

name: Lineage exists from source to consumption for every governed CDE
remediation: Missing lineage removes the ability to evidence derivation — prioritise by regulatory consumption.

name: Lineage has been refreshed since the last schema change on the path
remediation: Stale lineage is worse than none — it is trusted and wrong. Trigger re-harvest on schema change.

name: Party identifier is unique across the party master
remediation: Route duplicates to the stewardship merge queue; suppress from aggregation until resolved.

name: Every downstream party reference resolves to the party master
expression: count(fact.party_id NOT IN (SELECT party_id FROM party_master)) = 0
remediation: Quarantine orphaned records; raise a defect against the producing system rather than creating the missing master record.

name: Legal name is present for every active party
remediation: Block onboarding completion; existing gaps go to the steward remediation backlog with an owner-agreed date.

name: Legal name agrees between the party master and the contract system
remediation: Master is authoritative. Publish the delta to the contract system owner for correction at source.

name: Party type is a permitted value in the current code set version
remediation: Reject at the integration boundary; do not silently default to the most common type.

name: Contact points are syntactically valid for their channel
remediation: Flag to the servicing team; suppress notice delivery attempts against known-invalid contact points.

name: Every party subject to statutory notice has a designated contact point
remediation: Escalate to the Data Owner — an undeliverable statutory notice is a compliance failure, not a data-quality nuisance.

name: Jurisdiction is populated on every address
remediation: Derive from the country component where unambiguous; otherwise route to the steward. Never default to the domestic jurisdiction.

name: Addresses have been reviewed within the policy review period
remediation: Include in the periodic refresh campaign; report the ageing profile to the council quarterly.

name: Product identifier is unique within the product master
remediation: Withdraw the duplicate from the sellable catalogue and re-point transactions before deactivation.

name: Product version effective periods do not overlap
remediation: Correct the version boundaries at source; overlapping versions make point-in-time restatement ambiguous.

name: Effective date precedes expiry date on every product version
remediation: Reject at entry. Inverted date ranges silently exclude the product from every period filter.

name: Billed price matches the contracted price for the transaction date
remediation: Halt the billing run for the affected accounts; this rule protects against revenue leakage in both directions.

name: Rate changes are effective in the pricing engine on their approved date
remediation: Escalate to the custodian; a late rate change bills at the wrong price and requires customer remediation.

name: Leavers are marked inactive within one working day of the HR termination date
remediation: Trigger the joint HR and IAM leaver process; this rule is the upstream control for entitlement revocation.

name: Every entitlement belongs to an active employee identity
remediation: Revoke immediately and record in the access incident log. Orphaned entitlements are the classic leaver finding.

name: Every governed data set has at least one certified entitlement owner
remediation: Assign through the Data Owner; an uncertified data set cannot be evidenced as controlled.

name: Supplier identifier is unique across procurement and payables
remediation: Merge under stewardship; duplicate suppliers understate concentration risk and enable duplicate payment.

name: Every active contract carries an end or renewal date
remediation: Route to contract management. A missing renewal date becomes an auto-renewal nobody chose.

name: Every posting references a code in the active chart of accounts
remediation: Reject the posting at the interface; suspense postings must be exceptional and time-boxed.

name: Every active GL account maps to exactly one statutory disclosure line
remediation: Resolve with the financial reporting owner before period close; unmapped accounts fall out of the statements silently.

name: Cost centre is active in the hierarchy as at the posting date
expression: invalid_rate(cost_centre NOT active AS OF posting_date) = 0
remediation: Block the posting; retired cost centres produce roll-ups that do not tie to the management hierarchy.

name: Every processing purpose requiring consent has a consent record
expression: count(processing_event WHERE basis = consent AND consent_id IS NULL) = 0
remediation: Suspend the processing activity. This is a lawfulness control, not a quality metric.

name: Consent withdrawal propagates to consuming systems within the policy window
remediation: Escalate to the custodian of the lagging system; measure per system, not as an average across systems.

name: Every governed data set carries a retention class
remediation: Assign through the Data Owner with legal input. Without a retention class, deletion and retention are both indefensible.

name: No data set is retained beyond its retention class expiry without a recorded legal hold
expression: count(record WHERE age > retention_period AND legal_hold IS NULL) = 0
remediation: Trigger defensible disposal; over-retention is a reportable finding in most privacy regimes.

name: Transaction identifier is unique across the processing window
remediation: Quarantine and investigate; duplicates in the transaction spine double-count in every downstream aggregate.

name: Transaction counts reconcile between source and the analytical store
remediation: Halt publication of dependent reports until the break is explained; a reconciliation break is never rounding.

name: Currency is explicit on every monetary amount
expression: null_rate(currency_code WHERE amount IS NOT NULL) = 0
remediation: Reject at the boundary. An implied reporting currency is the most common silent corruption in consolidation.

name: Converted amounts use the rate applicable at the transaction date
remediation: Recompute and restate the affected period; record the rate source and date alongside the converted value.

name: Coded values are members of the referenced code set version
remediation: Reject at the interface and version the code set. Silently accepting unknown codes is how a controlled list stops being controlled.

name: Code set versions are distributed to consumers within the publication SLA
remediation: Report the lagging consumers to their custodians; divergent code set versions break cross-system joins.

name: Every hierarchy node resolves to a parent and the graph is acyclic
remediation: Correct in the source hierarchy before the reporting cycle; a cycle makes every roll-up non-terminating or silently truncated.

name: Hierarchy effective dates permit point-in-time restatement
remediation: Backfill effective dates with the change owner; without them a reorganisation rewrites history rather than versioning it.
